title: The play in a lesson; context
learning_objectives: Know the plot; explain James I and the Gunpowder Plot
key_content: Plot summary; James I; the Gunpowder Plot; Jacobean witchcraft
teaching_approach: Whole-play summary first so nobody is lost; context slides

title: PETAL paragraphs on Lady Macbeth
learning_objectives: Write a PETAL paragraph (Point, Evidence, Technique, Analysis, Link) on Lady Macbeth in Act 1
key_content: Act 1 scene 5: 'unsex me here'; imperatives; Lady Macbeth as ruthless
teaching_approach: PETAL modelled on the board and copied; every paragraph follows the five steps
assessment: PETAL paragraph; peer-marked against the frame

title: PETAL on guilt
learning_objectives: Write a PETAL paragraph on Macbeth's guilt in Act 2; name the technique then analyse it
key_content: Act 2 scene 2: 'Macbeth does murder sleep'; sleep imagery; blood imagery
teaching_approach: PETAL; the T step done explicitly before A

title: Acts 3 and 4: PETAL on the supernatural
learning_objectives: Write a PETAL paragraph on the witches and the apparitions
key_content: Act 3 scene 4 (Banquo's ghost); Act 4 scene 1 (the apparitions); the supernatural

title: Extract to whole play
learning_objectives: Use PETAL paragraphs to answer an extract question, then add one paragraph on another part of the play
key_content: Extract question structure; moving beyond the extract; alternative readings of Lady Macbeth (powerful versus vulnerable)
teaching_approach: PETAL for each paragraph; the Link step used to move to another scene

title: Act 5 and the ending
learning_objectives: Write about both Macbeths in Act 5; complete a character arc timeline
key_content: Act 5: sleepwalking ('Out, damned spot'); 'Tomorrow, and tomorrow'; 'dead butcher and his fiend-like queen'
teaching_approach: Read Act 5; character arc timeline for both Macbeths; PETAL on the ending
